purpose: Teach: 公用/専売/敬称/埋め立て/買い取り/廉価/覚書/即日

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、公用車の運用ルールを徹底します
lines.en: The police department is committed to strict enforcement of official vehicle protocols.
lines.style: Measured, official opening. Even tone, no inflection. Delivered as a formal assurance. Steady eye contact. Professional distance held throughout.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、専売的捜査権限の運用にご配慮、ありがたいです
lines.en: Yes. We're grateful for the police's careful approach to investigative authority.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Slightly slower pace, choosing words with care. Warm acknowledgment underneath the formality. Not obsequious—genuinely appreciative.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、被害者ご家族には敬称をつけて応対します
lines.en: We will address the victim's family with appropriate respect and honorifics.
lines.style: Formal, precise delivery. Slight emphasis on 'appropriate'—this matters. Calm, procedural tone. No warmth added, just competence.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、埋め立て地での違法投棄を捜査されてますね
lines.en: Yes. I understand the police are investigating illegal dumping at the landfill site.
lines.style: Thoughtful acknowledgment. Slight rise at the end—confirming rather than questioning. Engaged tone. Shows he's been paying attention.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、不正買い取り業者を摘発します
lines.en: We're taking action against unlicensed waste disposal operators.
lines.style: Firm, declarative. Light emphasis on 'unlicensed.' Confident without swagger. Brief and direct—this is what's happening.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、廉価詐欺商品の摘発にもご対応ですね
lines.en: Yes. I appreciate that the police are also cracking down on fraudulent discount schemes.
lines.style: Warm recognition in a professional register. Slight lift of respect in the tone. He's making a genuine connection while staying formal.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、関係機関と覚書を交わしました
lines.en: We've signed a memorandum of understanding with the relevant agencies.
lines.style: Steady, conclusive. Slight weight on 'memorandum'—this is solid, documented progress. Calm finality. No rush in the delivery.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。警察、緊急時の即日対応、頼もしいです
lines.en: Yes. The police's rapid same-day response during emergencies is reassuring.
lines.style: Warmer now, though still professional. Genuine relief underneath. Slower pace on 'same-day response'—he's emphasizing why this matters. Small exhale of trust.
